description:
In this video, I break down exactly how a Veteran rated at 100% disability (with a spouse and two dependents) could apply Dave Ramsey’s 25% take-home income rule when buying a home.

For 2026, a 100% disabled Veteran with a spouse and two children will receive about $4,427 per month in VA disability income. Using the Ramsey method, that means $1,106 per month could comfortably go toward a mortgage payment.

When you factor in $75 for taxes and $75 for insurance, and a 5% interest rate over 15 years - showing how disciplined budgeting can help Veterans buy homes with confidence and peace of mind.

We’ll walk through the math, talk about how this fits into a smart home-buying plan, and explain how VA disability income can create financial stability without stretching your budget.

🇺🇸 Veterans — this is your guide to using your benefits the Dave Ramsey way!

📈 Topics Covered:

VA disability income breakdown (2026 rates)

How to calculate 25% of take-home income

Applying Dave Ramsey’s home-buying principles

How VA disability income affects mortgage qualification

Budgeting for taxes, insurance, and interest rates

🔔 Subscribe for more Veteran-focused homeownership guides, VA loan insights, and financial strategies for service members and their families.

Schedule your call with me here 👉🏻 https://vahomexprt.com/book_call
